sourceFacts.qualification: Nominal dimensions obtained from the primary drawing text. A specimen and a visual review of this sales drawing are not available in this route. No fitted Prusa terminal is identified.

structureReferences.qualification: Original sketches and illustrative cross sections. No pixels, faces, meshes or manufacturer CAD are embedded in the model. Sheet14 establishes that finished-barrel dimensions require a separate crimp specification; no finished crimp fit is claimed.

primaryVisualEvidence.meaning: Structure and relative orientation/retention only; no scalar fit, SKU or verified seated datum from figures.

mountedReferenceFrame.meaning: The new functional terminal is authored directly in the mounted frame. This model datum is not a measured OEM seating position.

referenceScope: Standalone formed-barrel and compliant lance reference. The complete housing passage has finite model-fit evidence. Coupled loaded header-contact pose and finished production crimp remain unverified.
